title: Collection Merchandising Rail Self-Exclusion & Intentional Cross-Sell Preservation

requirement.summary: Collection detail pages must suppress redundant recommendation rails targeting the active collection itself (self-exclusion), while strictly preserving intentional cross-sell rails targeting distinct collections across both live storefront and builder preview.
requirement.user_outcome: Shoppers on collection pages (e.g. /c/sarees) see relevant cross-sell collections without encountering duplicate product rails of the collection they are already viewing.
preconditions: Active published theme with collection template sections
Storefront CollectionView and ThemePreviewFrame share identical section composition semantics

protected_behaviour: A collection recommendation rail targeting the active collection is omitted (self-exclusion)
A collection recommendation rail targeting a distinct collection is preserved (cross-sell preservation)
Primary product grid sections are never excluded regardless of collection slug
Section composition logic is identical between SSR storefront (CollectionView) and studio preview (ThemePreviewFrame)
Filtering is idempotent: filtering an already filtered section list yields the exact same list
forbidden_behaviour: Duplicate product rails of the active collection rendered on /c/:slug
Blanket removal of recommendation rails that erroneously strips intentional cross-sells
Divergence in rendered section order or content between builder preview frame and live storefront

executable_model.correspondence_bridge: src/lib/collection-composition.ts (isRedundantCollectionRail, filterCollectionSections) synchronized via SHA-256 drift gate

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Allow active collection rail to render alongside primary grid
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected redundant rail to be excluded
expected intentional cross-sell rail to be preserved
